items.title: Jeanette Kimball Interview, 1962-02-10
items.q: I was thinking trombones after Ridgely left.

ctx.x: No, Louie Barberin was our drummer then.
I was thinking trombones after Ridgely left. Do you remember who the trombones were?
Well, as I have foresaid, in the eight piece band we had Elvis Russo.
